tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Brand. Main brand colour: logo on light, hero cards, primary buttons in light theme.

tokens.name: pine
tokens.usage: Brand. Partner to Forest: pressed buttons, cards on dark, the class-session screen background.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Brand. Light page background; text and logo on Forest.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Brand. Highlight only: the full stop, one key word, the readiness arc, a single badge. Never body text. At most ~10% of a screen.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: Brand. The full stop on light backgrounds. Not for text.

tokens.name: gold-text
tokens.usage: Brand. Gold-coloured small text on light (6.1:1 on Paper).

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Brand. Soft fills: icon wells, selected chips, success-adjacent tints.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Brand. Body text on light.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Screen background (Paper in light).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, sheets, the tab bar.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Search fields, segmented-control track, inset wells.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Hero cards (next class, readiness) and the class-session header: a Forest block on light, a lifted Pine-green in dark.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind bottom sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (subtitles, metadata) on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps, helper text, placeholders, on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: text-on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse and pine.

tokens.name: text-on-inverse-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control edges (text fields, secondary buttons, checkboxes): 3:1+ on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, selected tab icon, switches on.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed state.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Gold fill for the one thing that matters on a screen (readiness arc, "Start class" badge).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links, eyebrow labels and inline highlights on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Icon wells, selected chip fill, gentle highlights.

tokens.name: on-tint
tokens.usage: Text and icons on tint.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard / switch-control focus ring (2px, offset 2px).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Understood topic, upload done, mastered. Text/icon on surface and success-container.

tokens.name: success-container
tokens.usage: Success banners and chips.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Due soon, weak topic, low readiness. Text/icon on surface and warning-container. Not gold: gold is the brand highlight.

tokens.name: warning-container
tokens.usage: Warning banners and chips.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, overdue, recording stopped, destructive actions.

tokens.name: danger-container
tokens.usage: Error banners, destructive confirmation.

tokens.name: recording
tokens.usage: The live recording dot and timer only.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: onboarding titles, readiness score headline.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Large screen titles (Home greeting, tab roots).

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Pushed-screen titles, hero card titles, sheet titles.

styles.name: headline
styles.sample: Your next class starts in 18 min
styles.usage: Card titles, list-row titles, section headers.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Zuri recorded today’s lecture and filed it under CSC 301.
styles.usage: Default reading text, chat messages, explanations.

styles.name: callout
styles.sample: Merge sort splits the list in half, sorts each half, then merges.
styles.usage: Secondary body: card descriptions, answer text in-class (short mode).

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: Metadata lines, button labels on small buttons, tab labels when shown.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Chip and badge text, chart labels, tab bar labels.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase section eyebrows (+10% tracking, per the brand guide). Write the text in capitals in the source.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Big numbers: readiness %, countdown minutes, hours needed. Use tabular numerals.

spacing.note: 4-point grid. Use these steps only; no 5, 7, 10, 13 or 15.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related lines; chip rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner gap in list rows; between a title and its metadata.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards in a list.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter (plus safe-area insets).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Hero card padding; gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap before a new group of sections; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top padding above large titles; onboarding vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, small thumbnails, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, text fields, list groups, segmented controls.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and hero cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets; the record button well.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, the record button, pills, progress tracks.

shadow.note: Light theme separates cards with a soft shadow; dark theme relies on the lighter surface-raised and a hairline border instead.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and list groups on surface.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Floating action button, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and the tab bar edge.

size.note: Fixed sizes that follow iOS and Material guidance.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for anything tappable (Material 48dp; iOS 44pt).

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Primary and secondary buttons, text fields.

tokens.name: control-height-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons inside cards, chips with actions.

tokens.name: tab-bar-height
tokens.usage: Tab bar content height, before the bottom safe-area inset.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Inline icons in chips and metadata.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: List-row and button icons.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Tab bar and header icons.

tokens.name: record-button
tokens.usage: The record / stop control in class.
